answer: We formulate dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices with zero-knowledge verifiable delay to enforce staking collateral, fencing the deep canyon of states. Since cumulative slashing penalties eclipse rewards during identity multiplication, this capital barrier, akin to a basalt ledge, yields a strictly negative expected attack payoff. Thus, this cryptoeconomic asymmetry drives robust Nash equilibrium convergence, since unilateral sybil deviations guarantee destructive utility for rational multi-agent adversaries.
